question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.**

Collection of money through illegal means without any hard work increased the ___________(greed) of the corrupt officials.
solution: The correct answer is: Cupidity [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Greed means intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth, power, or food. (किसी चीज की तीव्र और स्वार्थी इच्छा, विशेषकर धन, शक्ति या भोजन) • Example -* He was motivated by pure greed.* • Marked option Cupidity means greed for money or possessions. (धन या संपत्ति का लालच) • Example -* His eyes gave him away, shining with cupidity.* • It is clear that 'Greed' and 'Cupidity' are similar in meaning. Therefore the correct answer is option 1.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Stability **means the state or quality of being stable. (स्थिर होने की अवस्था या गुण) • **Curiosity **means a strong desire to know or learn something. (कुछ जानने या सीखने की तीव्र इच्छा) • **Reliability **means the quality of being able to be trusted or believed because of working or behaving well. (काम करने या अच्छा व्यवहार करने के कारण भरोसेमंद होने या विश्वास करने में सक्षम होने का गुण) 32:Tad9, The correct answer is: **Instanteneous**
